title: Polynomial-time closure under query formation
statement: Fix a finite bit vector $b\in\{0,1\}^{n_b}$, and let $T,A,X:\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^*$ be polynomial-time computable. For a bit string $z$, form the concatenation of $b$, the encoding of $T(z)$ obtained by doubling each bit, the separator $00$, the similarly encoded $A(z)$, another separator $00$, and $X(z)$. The resulting function of $z$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $n_b\in\mathbb{N}$ and a fixed bit vector $b$ of length $n_b$
